description: This Java source file defines a utility class `ServiceUtil` within the OFBiz framework that provides various methods for handling service responses, security checks, message generation, and service context management. It includes functions for checking service result statuses, constructing standardized error and success response maps, security verification for user permissions, message formatting, and other utility functions relevant to service processing.

classes.name: ServiceUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for handling service responses, security checks, message formatting, and other common service-related functions within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates an error based on RESPONSE_MESSAGE.

methods.name: isFailure
methods.description: Checks if the service result indicates failure based on RESPONSE_MESSAGE.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Determines if the service result indicates success (neither error nor failure).

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Constructs a standardized error response map with a message or message list.

methods.name: returnFailure
methods.description: Constructs a failure response map, optionally with messages.

methods.name: returnProblem
methods.description: Core method to assemble a response map with response type, messages, error details, and nested error information.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Constructs a success response map with optional messages.

methods.name: returnMessage
methods.description: Creates a response map with a specified response code and optional message.

methods.name: getPartyIdCheckSecurity
methods.description: Verifies the user's partyId against the userLogin and checks permissions, returning the partyId if authorized.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets error, event, or default messages as request attributes for display.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and formats error and success messages from the service result, setting them in the request attributes.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Aggregates and returns all error messages from the result map.

methods.name: makeErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats error messages from the result map with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeSuccessMessage
methods.description: Formats success messages from the result map with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeMessageList
methods.description: Formats a list of messages with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: addErrors
methods.description: Extracts error messages from a call result and adds them to provided list and map.

methods.name: genericDateCondition
methods.description: Constructs a date-based condition response map based on fromDate and thruDate.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the user login, possibly impersonating another user if specified.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale from context or default.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Creates a context map from key-value pairs, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: setServiceFields
methods.description: Prepares service input fields, including authorization info, for execution.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource bundle name for service error labels.
